name: Anbernic RG CubeXX
identify: helperFunctions.sh: cpuinfo CPU part "*0xd03*" (H700) -> reads BASEOS_TARGET from /etc/baseos-release; case "rgcubexx" -> PLATFORM=AnbernicRGCubeXX

pad.note: A/B/X/Y, L1/R1, digital L2/R2, SELECT/START, MENU (plus its KEY_GOTO tap pulse), D-pad hat, stick axes and FF rumble, all on one event1 node (also enumerates as js0). Its EV_KEY bitmask also advertises KEY_ESC/KEY_VOLUMEDOWN/KEY_VOLUMEUP, but those three never actually fire on this node (controller-matrix C2 / RG28XX diagnostic capture).

vol.note: vendor's own typo for the node name, kept verbatim. KEY_VOLUMEUP 115 / KEY_VOLUMEDOWN 114 measured arriving here (not on event1) on RG34XX SP and RG40XX V by the NextUI port, and identified as the volume node in the RG28XX diagnostic capture (controller-matrix event2 entry; measured: the lab capturesAnbernicRGCubeXX-20260824.txt for this bucket's own node). On the RG CubeXX (2026-11-12) the volume keys came on ANBERNIC-keys, not here.

VOL_UP.note: on the RG CubeXX the key arrives on ANBERNIC-keys (2026-11-12)

VOL_DOWN.note: on the RG CubeXX the key arrives on ANBERNIC-keys (2026-11-12)

absent.LID: no lid on any model in this bucket
absent.HOME: cfg B_HOME="DOESNT_EXIST"; MENU is spruce's home key on this line (matrix)
absent.FN_SWITCH: no latching Fn switch on the Anbernic XX line; cfg exports none (matrix)
absent.FN_LEFT: no Fn keys distinct from L3/R3 on the Anbernic XX line; cfg exports none (matrix)
absent.FN_RIGHT: no Fn keys distinct from L3/R3 on the Anbernic XX line; cfg exports none (matrix)

notes: SPRUCE_DEVICE_NAME is computed at runtime; rgcubexx has its own named arm in AnbernicXXCommon.cfg: SPRUCE_DEVICE_NAME="Anbernic RG CubeXX" (note the cfg's own string says "RG CubeXX", not the retail "RG Cube" used as this file's model name -- likely spruce mirroring the XX-suffix convention of its sibling buckets (RG35XX/RG40XX/RG34XX), not a second model. Button Reader's model-name match against SPRUCE_DEVICE_NAME should account for this if it ever needs exact-string matching.

VOL_KEY_WATCHER_PATH/POWER_KEY_WATCHER_PATH/CONTROLLER_KEY_WATCHER_PATH are exported in AnbernicXXCommon.cfg (event0/event2/event1) but nothing in the h700 tree reads them -- dead variables, not evidence for any control's source (grep of spruce/scripts at spruce_ref 0dccf5276b).
models are spruce's own SPRUCE_DEVICE_NAME values (AnbernicXXCommon.cfg); Button Reader matches the unit's name against them
